title: Meliora
tagline: Meliora: A cosmic saga of guardians from planet Terren, battling the deceit of the Fudiverso to forge a new universe of harmony and progress.
description:
CONCEPT

The concept of Meliora is not just a comic book, it is a ticket to world beyond a good read. It embraces first principles and individual responsibility to encourage a new generation of builders to join the blockchain trenches.

Book Mechanics
The use of the frame is simple. You are welcomed to a journey of world building. Where we have create lore to cast you into a world beyond the metaverse. It is a place where regeneration, cooperation and prosperity are all intertwined. A place of unity -- Meliora.


Then, after minting you will be eligible to access the full length story and click through mechanics to immerse yourself in a click through game that will allow you to go through the different blockchain mechanics necessary to learn how to make use of blockchain.
how_its_made:
DESIGN

The characters  were created by hand on digital application Procreate. Some images were generated using Midjourney to create background scenes. In order to get the text lay out we made use of Canva so we could convey a narrative. 

WEB3

Using Neynar I was able to create a no-code story focused on inviting the reader to get curious about the possibilities of this new universe. 

The NFT available to collect to continue reading the story is minted on Optimism & Base, which uses Privy as a sign in option to connect wallet.
